mentions.author: matchmike1313
mentions.storyTitle: Ask HN: How much time do you invest in writing tests?
mentions.text: I spend about 30% of my time on a new feature writing tests. BTW that is in RoR which the primary language I code in. I would recommend watching this video by Sandi Matz on testing: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=URSWYvyc42M. I have used this methodology a lot to determine what I should test.
